motifs.name: foreground_leafy_tree
motifs.description: Isolate the large foreground tree rising in front of the pavilion: twisting trunk and exposed roots, forked branches, and clustered fine leaves extending across the middle of the scene. Mask out the pavilion, fence, field bands, seals, and background washes except where the tree linework visibly overlaps them.
must_preserve: gnarled double trunk with dark contour lines
exposed root forms at the base
forking branch structure visible through foliage
dense clusters of short needle-like leaf strokes
pale ink wash and darker accent strokes on bark
